title: Samsung Galaxy M30s Unboxing & First Look - The NEW Performer #GoMonster:fire::fire::fire:
description: Namaskaar dosto, is video mein maine aapse baat ki hai samsung ke brand new galaxy m series ke latest phone galaxy m30s ke baare mein, aur share ki hai isi isi galaxy m30s smartphone ki ek unboxing First look, baat kare kuch details isi galaxy m30s ke baare mein yaha hume ek 6.4 "ka ek fhd+ super amoled display milta hai infinity-ut ke saath, iske axynos 9611 Octacore Processor 10nm Pe Based Aur Option Hai 4GB/6GB RAM ka 64GB/128GB storage ke saath mein. Depth Camera Ke Saath Aur Ek 16MP Ka Selfie Camera Hai, Aur Finally 6000mah Ki Badi Battery UsB-C Port Aur Samsung Ki 15watt Adaptive Fast Charging Ke Saath. Galaxy m30s ki yeh unboxing aur ek first look video video pasand aayegi.   Galaxy m30s price: 4GB + 64GB = 13,999inr 6GB + 128GB = 16,999inr  Share, support, subscribe !!!
